artworks.title: Bertrand, dis donc, s'ils allaient nous faire...
artworks.description: The image shows a cartoon illustration featuring two men seated in a carriage. The man on the left is dressed in a dark jacket, trousers, and a tall top hat, with a mustache. The man next to him has long hair under a white top hat, a goatee, a dark coat over a white vest, and a patterned cravat. Both men sit facing forward, with the man on the right holding a whip. Various figures in similar hats surround the carriage, some gesturing towards the occupants. The background includes sketched buildings, suggesting an urban setting with a bustling street.

artworks.title: Farce dramatique
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene inside a room with three figures. The image depicts three individuals involved in a dramatic situation. The style of the drawing is influenced by caricature and satire, characterized by exaggerated expressions and dynamic body postures.

artworks.title: Salut! Terre de l'hospitalité...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man gesturing in front of a customs office with packages around him. The scene is rendered in a detailed, monochromatic style, emphasizing outlines and shadows. It depicts a setting labeled as "Douanes de Belgique." The man in the foreground has a dramatic pose, holding a hat in one hand. Various packages and parcels are scattered around, indicating a customs or border setting. The overall composition suggests motion and emotion.

artworks.title: L'Adoption - Ah ça! Robert, mon ami...
artworks.description: The illustration shows three figures positioned outdoors. Two men stand on either side of a child in the center. The men wear long coats, high-collared shirts, and top hats. The man on the left holds a cane, while the man on the right has a rounder face. The child wears a bonnet, a long dress, and touches her face. The characters appear to be engaged in conversation. The background is lightly shaded, implying an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Inventaire chez un veuf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interaction at a table. The scene includes two individuals standing and one seated at a table. The person on the left has open arms and seems expressive, while the other stands upright with their back turned. The seated person is writing or taking notes, observing the interaction. The background features a framed object. The drawing is monochrome with detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: L'homme in naturalibus
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals positioned face-to-face in a rustic room or cabin. The person on the left has a hunched posture with arms crossed over their chest, a long nose, a cap, and a tunic. The person on the right stands upright holding a cylindrical object, with long hair and a pronounced brow, draped in a cloth. The background shows wooden planks on the floor and walls, with a bench on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: A tous les coeurs bien nés que la patrie est chère!!!
artworks.description: This drawing shows two male figures near a sign labeled "Frontiere de France." One figure holds a top hat in one hand, while the other clutches his bag. The second figure appears hunched over, gripping his bag tightly. The sketch style captures the folds of their garments and the texture of their bags.

artworks.title: Musique pyrothecnique, Charivarique et Diabolique
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an orchestra scene. The image portrays musicians in comical distress. In the forefront, a central figure is conducting with fervor, holding a baton dramatically. Beside the conductor, one musician is kneeling, holding a large wind instrument with exaggerated effort. Another musician in the background has a humorous expression. The musicians are surrounded by sheet music and instruments, enhancing the theatrical and cartoonish quality of the scene. Fine lines and shading accentuate the dramatic expressions and postures of the figures, capturing a lively and humorous orchestral parody.

artworks.title: Piétié Filiale
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a man delivering a speech to an audience. The man is dressed formally and standing at the center, speaking to a group of people. He is gesturing with his arms while the audience, depicted with minimal detail, listens attentively. In the background, there are elements like a patterned railing and a shovel. The drawing style is detailed, with exaggerated features and poses typical of caricatures.

artworks.title: Nouveautés philantropiques...
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing. The man on the right holds up a large, ornamented curtain. He has curly hair and a surprised or determined expression. He wears a dark coat and trousers. The man on the left has a long nose and a feathered hat. He also wears a dark coat and holds the curtain. In the background are draped curtains, and some cylindrical objects are on the left. The scene has exaggerated facial features and a dramatic pose.

artworks.title: (Robert) Hé bien! mon cher directeur...
artworks.description: Two men are standing close to each other, engaged in a discussion. The man on the left is wearing a top hat and a long coat with its lower buttons fastened. He has long wavy hair and distinct facial features, including a prominent nose. The man on the right is slightly hunched forward, wearing a dark suit with a high collar. His hair is parted and combed back, exposing a high forehead and narrow face. The background shows a door with the word "CAISSE" and another door labeled "CABINET DU MR. DIRECTEUR."

artworks.title: Oui, Madame, je suis tout dévoué a notre... Prince...
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a room. One person is standing, wearing a black suit and a top hat, while the other is seated in an armchair, wearing a long dress and a bonnet.

artworks.title: Le Préfet de l'Empire
artworks.description: The illustration features a man standing in a diagonal pose. He leans on a cane with his right hand and holds a pair of spectacles or pince-nez up to his eye with his left hand. The man has sharp facial features and white, curly hair under a black top hat. He is dressed in a formal black suit with a long coat, waistcoat, and trousers, paired with a white collar and cravat. The backdrop shows a shop window display with various objects and curtains. This urban setting likely depicts a street with shopfronts.

artworks.title: L'Agent d'affaires
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure in formal attire approaching a door labeled "Justice de Paix." The drawing depicts a figure wearing a high top hat, a dark coat tails, white cravat, and striped trousers, holding some papers while walking towards a door with the words "Justice de Paix" written on it. The figure's posture and expression convey a sense of urgency or determination. The scene is set within an interior space, suggested by the visible staircase and corridor in the background. The illustration employs sharp lines and shading to provide depth and dimension to the scene.

artworks.title: Le Ravageur
artworks.description: This image depicts two individuals on a street in the rain. The person on the right is in a crouched position with their body bent over, reaching down to the ground. This person is seen from the side and wears a black cap, a light-colored shirt with the sleeves rolled up, and dark pants that appear to be rolled up past the knees. They are barefoot and holding a basket. The person on the left is holding a large umbrella over their head. They are seen from the side, partially turned away, dressed in a long, dark gown and bonnet. The background shows a street scene with tall buildings visible amidst diagonal rain lines. The ground appears wet and reflective.

artworks.title: Le Maraudeur
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a slight forward lean. The person has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and an open mouth. They are wearing a tall, dark hat and an overcoat with pants. The person is pointing upwards with one hand and holding a string behind their back. Nearby, there is a cat perched on a ledge on the left and a sleeping dog on the ground. The background features a textured surface resembling a wall.

artworks.title: Le Ramasseur de bouts de cigares
artworks.description: The image shows a man in motion, leaning forward with both hands raised near his chest. He wears a tall top hat and tattered clothing. Two figures beside him wear similar attire, with one holding a cigar. The background includes trees and a cobblestone ground.

artworks.title: Le Marchand d'habits
artworks.description: The image displays a man walking on a cobblestone street. The man is in profile, looking to the right, carrying various items. He has distinct facial features, such as a nose and facial hair, potentially a beard or mustache. He wears a tall hat with hair flowing from underneath, layered clothing including a long coat or cloak, a scarf, and holds an umbrella and a possible guitar while additional garments are under his arm. The background features a faint horse outline and a second sketchy figure, implying a busy street scene in an urban setting near a building or alley.

artworks.title: Le Tondeur de chiens
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals on a cobblestone street. One person, a man, is seated and grooming a dog in his lap. The man has short, slicked-back hair and wears a short-sleeved shirt, a vest, and loose pants. An elderly woman stands nearby, wearing a shawl and a bonnet, looking concerned. She is clasping her hands together. In the background are buildings and a sign post near the seated man. The sky is shaded.

artworks.title: L'Acteur des Funambules
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking in a snowy street scene. The man is eating as he walks briskly in a snow-covered area. He is wearing checkered attire, a long coat, and a tall top hat. Snowflakes are falling around him. The man appears joyful and content as he eats from a small packet. Onlookers are behind a rail, observing him. A sign to the right reads "ENTRÉE DES ACTEURS." The actor is approaching a door. The drawing captures a moment of simplicity and delight in the actor's routine against a wintry backdrop.

artworks.title: 7 heures du matin
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting up in bed with a cat and a dog beside him. He is smiling and wearing a bedcap and a nightshirt. There is a candle on a nightstand, clothes on a chair, slippers on the floor, and a patterned curtain next to the bed.

artworks.title: Une heure - Promenade au Luxembourg
artworks.description: The image depicts a man holding an open umbrella, wearing a top hat, long coat, vest, and trousers. His features are exaggerated, with a long nose and prominent chin. He is walking a small dog on a leash in a park setting with trees and water. In the background, a person is partially submerged in the water, looking up, and a group of people, including another man in a top hat, can be seen to the left. The illustration is filled with detailed line work, creating a whimsical and dynamic atmosphere.

artworks.title: 2 heures - Le gouter d'Azor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interaction outside a shop. Two individuals are standing on a stone path, with one holding a cane and the other holding a circular object in their hand, possibly food, while a small dog stands nearby on its hind legs, reaching towards the item. In the background, there is a window display with what appears to be baked goods and a hanging poultry item. The style of the drawing is detailed with shading and expressive character features. The setting gives the impression of a comical everyday scene from the 19th century.

artworks.title: 9 heures du soir
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man lying in bed holding a candlestick and appearing to snuff out a candle. He is propped up against a pillow, wearing a nightcap and a nightshirt. The bed is adorned with a floral quilt and pillows, with cats resting nearby. In the background, heavy curtains hang around the bed, and there is a glass and a small bottle on a bedside table.
